And in Targum Onkelos as well,
for even in the time of Onkelos
"Atzeres" in the language of the Sages,
from the mouths of Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua,
וְהָעִנְיָן עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ
The matter is based on what they said in the Midrash
(שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה ז, ב; וְתַנְחוּמָא פִּנְחָס טו):
the Atzeres of the Chag of Sukkos
corresponding to the Atzeres of Pesach," etc.
This implies that the Atzeres after Pesach
עִנְיָן אֶחָד עִם שְׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת דְּחַג.
is one matter with Shemini Atzeres of Sukkos.
And regarding the meaning of Shemini Atzeres,
אִיתָא בְּשֵׁם הָאֲרִ"י הַקָּדוֹשׁ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
it is brought in the name of the holy Arizal
that it is an expression of absorption:
it is the absorption of the holiness of the light
For Sukkos is "the time of our rejoicing"
through the mitzvah of the four species,
וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם לִפְנֵי ה׳ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְגוֹמֵר (וַיִּקְרָא כג, מ),
"And you shall rejoice before Hashem your G-d," etc. (Vayikra 23:40),
and "whoever takes the palm branches in his hand,
we know that he is the victor"
and through the mitzvah of sukkah,
"And you shall rejoice on your festival" (Devarim 16:14).
But on Shemini Atzeres the rejoicing comes
only from the holiness absorbed into it
since on it there is no mitzvah at all.
Likewise, Pesach is "the time of our freedom,"
and the essence of freedom is from the yetzer hara.
For with the tenth plague Bnei Yisrael went out
from all ten impure crowns of the kelipah
striking for Mitzrayim and healing for Yisrael
בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב לו, א).
in the holy Zohar, Zohar II 36a).
And with the tenth plague, the plague of the firstborn,
being bound to the root of Keser Elyon,
at the very beginning of Thought.
וּמִכָּל מָקוֹם חָלַף וְעָבַר אַחַר כָּךְ,
Nevertheless, it passed and was gone afterward,
שֶׁהֲרֵי בַּיָּם שׁוּב הָיָה עֲלֵיהֶם הַקִּטְרוּג:
for at the Sea there was again the accusation against them:
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמּוּבָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קע, ב).
as is brought in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 170b).
רַק עַל הַיָּם בִּקְרִיעַת יַם סוּף
Only at the Sea, at the splitting of the Yam Suf,
שֶׁהָיָה אָז גַּם כֵּן הִתְגַּלּוּת עַתִּיקָא,
for there was then also the revelation of Atika,
since "the splitting of the Yam Suf depends on Atika,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב נב, ב).
as written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 52b).
That is why it is written in the Torah,
וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי עֲצֶרֶת לַה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ (דְּבָרִים טז, ח),
"And on the seventh day an Atzeres to Hashem your G-d" (Devarim 16:8),
for then the holiness was absorbed.
Yet this is only from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
for in truth, that which is stated
(מְכִילְתָּא, שִׁירָה ג; וְזֹהַר חֵלֶק ב סד, ב):
similar to what the Rokeach wrote:
"There is no strength like that of chassidus at its outset."
וְאוֹמְרִים בְּשֵׁם הָרַבִּי רַבִּי בּוּנֶם זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה
And they say in the name of the Rebbe Reb Bunim, zt"l,
that about this it is said,
כִּי לֹא מֵחָכְמָה שָׁאַלְתָּ עַל זֶה (קֹהֶלֶת ז, י):
"For it is not out of wisdom that you ask about this" (Koheles 7:10):
that it is not from his own wisdom,
but only on loan, for the moment,
and they show it to him
only so that the person himself
through his own toil and effort.
And this too was the vision
at the splitting of the Yam Suf.
וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וְלֹא מָצְאוּ מַיִם (שְׁמוֹת טו, כב),
"They went three days and did not find water" (Shemos 15:22),
וְאֵין מַיִם אֶלָּא תּוֹרָה (בָּבָא קַמָּא פב, א),
and "water means nothing but Torah" (Bava Kamma 82a),
וּבַזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב ס, א):
and in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 60a):
"The Holy One, blessed be He, is called Torah."
This means that the light was hidden from them
that they had had at the Sea,
וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לִשְׁתּוֹת מַיִם מִמָּרָה (שְׁמוֹת טו, כג).
"they could not drink water from Marah" (Shemos 15:23).
The main absorption of the holiness
took place on Shavuos, the time of the giving of our Torah.
except one who occupies himself with Torah" —
Only, in the Torah it is written
regarding the seventh day of Pesach,
for from the side of Hashem Yisbarach
He saw then that the holiness had already been absorbed.
And as we said (Shevi'i shel Pesach),
that they show a person beforehand
that he will be able to receive afterward
And regarding Shemini Atzeres it is written,
"It shall be an Atzeres for you" (Bamidbar 29:35).
it is expounded regarding the dispute of
It may be that on Shemini Atzeres
also from the side of Yisrael,
since there is no further Atzeres after it.
וְזֶה הָעִנְיָן בִּקְרִיאַת שֵׁם חַג זֶה,
This is the matter behind the naming of this festival,
based on what we said regarding Pesach,
that it is called in the Torah "Chag HaMatzos"
and in the language of the Sages "Chag HaPesach."
עַל שֵׁם קִילּוּסוֹ שֶׁל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ,
after the praise of Hashem Yisbarach,
אֲשֶׁר פָּסַח עַל בָּתֵּי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל (שְׁמוֹת יב, כז)
"Who passed over the houses of Bnei Yisrael" (Shemos 12:27)
and stood at the doorways of Yisrael.
עַל שֵׁם שֶׁבַח יִשְׂרָאֵל, חַג הַמַּצּוֹת,
after the praise of Yisrael, "Chag HaMatzos,"
which is the nullification of the leaven in the dough
So too here, in the language of the Sages,
Chag HaShavuos is called by the name "Atzeres,"
עַל שֵׁם קְלִיטַת קְדוּשַּׁת חַג הַפֶּסַח
after the absorption of the holiness of the festival of Pesach,
which was absorbed at Mattan Torah
עַל יְדֵי הַמַּרְאֶה שֶׁהֶרְאָה לָהֶם מִקּוֹדֶם
by means of the vision He had shown them beforehand
at the splitting of the Yam Suf,
And Hashem Yisbarach, in the Torah she'b'ksav,
calls the festival by the name "Shavuos,"
which are the praise of Yisrael,
דְּאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג צז, ב):
as it is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 97b):
מַה כְּתִיב, וְסָפְרָה לָּהּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים (וַיִּקְרָא טו, כח),
"What is written? 'She shall count for herself seven days' (Vayikra 15:28);
"the Holy One, blessed be He, said:
From here onward, the count is for purity —
'And you shall count for yourselves,'" etc.
The counting is the yearning to become pure;
and so Yisrael, after the Exodus from Mitzrayim,
in their yearning to receive the Torah,
to be refined in all the middos,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכוּ לְמַתַּן תּוֹרָה.
and through this they merited Mattan Torah.
הַיְינוּ שֶׁזָּכוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל יְדֵי זֶה,
meaning that Yisrael merited through this —
through the seven weeks that they counted.
And this is the matter of what is written, "b'Shavuoseichem" —
The beginning of the pasuk is
"And on the day of the first fruits" (Bamidbar 28:26),
is the aspect of the Tree of Life,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ וְרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא
as written in the holy Zohar and Raya Mehemna
when they became "engraved upon the Tablets" —
freedom from the Angel of Death
and they became the Tree of Life.
And this is what is written in Raya Mehemna
and it is not written how many they are," etc.;
to include above and below," etc.;
he made of them a specification:
שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְשִׁבְעַת יָמִים (מְלָכִים א ח, סה) וְכוּלֵּי.
'seven days and seven days' (Melachim I 8:65)," etc.
This refers also to the light
of the aspect of the Shechinta Ila'ah, the Upper Shechinah,
which is the meaning of "seven and seven."
And so it is written in the holy Zohar
according to the count that you count, seven weeks;
and then the Holy One, blessed be He, draws down
a flow of seven levels below," etc.
And this is why the pasuk uses
meaning that it became the Tree of Life,
that the first blemish was repaired,
and from the side of Yisrael.
שֶׁהָעֲצֶרֶת הִיא גַּם כֵּן מִצַּד יִשְׂרָאֵל,
For the Atzeres too is from the side of Yisrael:
the absorption of the holiness of Pesach, the time of our freedom,
הִיא גַּם כֵּן עַל יְדֵי שְׁנֵי שִׁבְעַת.
And this is why Onkelos translates it "b'Atzarteichon."
